input.quote: 12.3 Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no non-compete, exclusivity, or field-of-use restriction on Customer. Clause 12.3 expressly confirms the preferred position: Customer remains free to develop, acquire, license, sell or use any product or service, engage any supplier, and operate in any field or territory, with Vendor acknowledging that no exclusivity or non-compete commitment has been made. The only competition-related covenant, clause 12.4, binds Vendor (it may not develop or market a service competing with Customer's analytics products during the term), which benefits our party and is not flagged. Section 13.4's reverse-engineering limit is a standard IP protection, not a business restriction. No redline required.
